Implementation Plan

Key files to create/modify
- docs/requirements.md: Define “create things” scope, constraints, and success criteria.
- design/create-feature-spec.md: API, data model, UX flows, permission matrix.
- api/create_controller.{py|ts}: Endpoints for create/list/get/delete creations.
- services/generator_service.{py|ts}: Core creation logic with plugin architecture.
- models/creation.{py|ts}: Creation entity, validation, status lifecycle.
- db/migrations/ add_creation_tables.sql: Tables for creations, versions, metadata.
- ui/CreatePage.{tsx|jsx}: Form, preview, submission, activity.
- workers/creator_worker.{py|ts}: Async job execution and retries.
- integrations/storage_client.{py|ts}: Persist created artifacts/blobs.
- tests/*: Unit, integration, e2e, contract tests.

Primary design decisions
- Creation domain model: id, type, input spec, output URIs, status, audit.
- Plugin-based generators: interface (validate, execute, serialize), sandboxed.
- Async job queue for long-running tasks; idempotent operations.
- Content policy and safety filters pre/post generation.
- Versioning of creations and deterministic replays (seeded runs).
- Observability: structured logs, metrics, traces; artifact lineage.
- Access control: RBAC on create/read/delete; quotas and rate limits.

Risks
- Ambiguous scope of “things” → plugin creep; mitigate with strict spec.
- Resource overuse/cost spikes; enforce quotas and caching.
- Safety/compliance of generated content; implement filters and audits.
- Determinism across environments; pin dependencies and seeds.
- Storage bloat; lifecycle policies and deduplication.
